objects.triage_summary: A real-space wrapped-kernel pipeline with nested Gauss-Legendre quadrature, Tanh-Sinh and Monte Carlo cross-checks gives the estimate I_WP(0.025) = 4.756917657978e-6 over the rigidity zone (not an enclosure) and a corrected-CS zone integral of 8.574e-4. It also reports probe conditional laws to 25 digits and outer-shell and wedge pieces.
